how: hand-written from the report in PSCatLabs/pscat-mcp#17: an HTTP client or hand-written integration that sends Accept: application/json and nothing else. Which real clients do this is not known; the server answers them with JSON (the src/http.rs accept_json middleware adds text/event-stream)
note: Fixed in #17: rmcp alone answers 406 to these requests; the server adds text/event-stream to a POST's Accept when it allows JSON, and answers with a JSON body. Each request meets the default expect (2xx and a JSON-RPC result).
